[b]     For troubleshooting[/b]:

[list]
[*][b]If you’re experiencing issues with your saved game, such as annoying bushes appearing on the map, here are two solutions:[/b]
[/list]
[b]     Option 1: 

[/b][b]     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/127?tab=files]Stardew Valley Save Editor[/url]:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]This tool allows you to delete the bushes directly from your save file. Once deleted, they will never reappear.[/b]
[/list]
[b]    Option 2: 
[/b]
[b]    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304?tab=files]Destroyable Bushes[/url]: 
[/b][list]
[*][b]This mod allows you to break the bushes in-game. They will respawn after a certain amount of time, which can be configured in the mod settings.[/b]
[/list]

 [b]    These options should help you resolve any issues with unwanted bushes on your map. 😊


[/b]
